method.name: GenerateDeterministicHashCode
method.summary: Generate a stable, framed content-integrity hash code using canonical type names, exact scalar representations, and alias/cycle preservation.

method.name: GenerateDeterministicHashCodeAsync
method.summary: Generate a stable content-integrity hash code using the synchronous canonical encoder.

method.name: GenerateDeterministicSHA512
method.summary: Generate a stable SHA-512 content-integrity hash of a length-framed canonical graph encoding.
method.remarks: Preserves aliases and cycles, normalizes unordered graph structure, and applies exact scalar bit representations. Type names omit assembly identity. Unsupported or over-limit graphs fail under the configured exception policy.

method.name: GenerateDeterministicSHA512Async
method.summary: Generate a stable SHA-512 content-integrity hash of a canonical graph encoding asynchronously.
method.remarks: Uses the same graph encoder as the synchronous API and checks cancellation during capture and canonical labeling.

method.name: ComputeSHA512Async
method.summary: Compute a SHA-512 hash for binary content in bounded chunks.

method.name: ComputeSHA512AsyncMemory
method.summary: Compute a SHA-512 hash for memory content in bounded chunks.

method.name: GenerateDeterministicHashCodeCore
method.summary: Generate a deterministic graph-identity hash code using a shared serialization pipeline.

method.name: GenerateDeterministicSHA512Core
method.summary: Build and hash the canonical, framed graph encoding with SHA-512.

method.name: GenerateContentIntegritySHA512
method.summary: Compute the SHA-512 content-integrity digest for a DataItem's captured content projection.
method.param: DataItem whose content is represented by the supplied snapshot.
Explicit content fields captured for the owner.
Token forwarded to canonical graph encoding to request cancellation.
method.returns: The SHA-512 digest of the canonical encoding of the owner's content projection.
method.remarks: Encodes the supplied snapshot using the ContentIntegrity profile and hashes the resulting canonical graph bytes.
